item.text: [{"task_id":"14754a24","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    marker = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    substrate = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    paint = int(round(params['colors'][2]))","    required = int(round(params['minimum'][0]))","    offsets = [(int(round(pair[0])), int(round(pair[1]))) for pair in params['cross']]","    out = grid.copy()","    height, width = grid.shape","    candidates = []","    for row in range(height):","        for col in range(width):","            cells = []","            markers = set()","            valid = True","            for dr, dc in offsets:","                rr, cc = row + dr, col + dc","                if rr < 0 or rr >= height or cc < 0 or cc >= width:","                    continue","                value = grid[rr, cc]","                if value != marker and value != substrate:","                    valid = False","                    break","                cells.append((rr, cc))","                if value == marker:","                    markers.add((rr, cc))","            if valid and len(markers) >= required:","                candidates.append((cells, markers))","    for cells, markers in candidates:","        selected = True","        for other_cells, other_markers in candidates:","            if len(other_markers) > len(markers) and markers.intersection(other_markers):","                selected = False","                break","        if selected:","            for rr, cc in cells:","                if grid[rr, cc] == substrate:","                    out[rr, cc] = paint","    return out"],"shapes":{"colors":[3],"minimum":[1],"cross":[5,2]},"params":{"colors":[4,5,2],"minimum":[2],"cross":[[0,0],[-1,0],[1,0],[0,-1],[0,1]]},"rationale":"Complete yellow-marked five-cell crosses by recoloring their gray cells red. Crosses may be clipped by grid boundaries. When possible crosses share yellow markers, prefer those containing more yellow markers, eliminating incidental partial matches."}]
